title: Stylish Woman on Suburban Sidewalk, 1950s Americana Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a stylish young woman posing with hands on her hips on a residential sidewalk. She wears a pleated knee-length skirt, a decorative light-colored collared blouse, and kitten heels, sporting a classic mid-1950s short curled coiffure. Behind her lies a post-war suburban neighborhood complete with manicured lawns, single-story tract ranch homes, and parked vintage automobiles under a bright, sunny sky.
